---
title: What your app can do
description: A short overview of platform capabilities — not an API catalog.
sidebar:
  order: 13
---

The app you build can use a set of platform capabilities. This table is a map, **not** a developer handbook. Say what you want in chat; do not look up internal method names.

| What you might want | Covered |
|---|---|
| Call AI from the app | Yes |
| Send email to users | Yes |
| Take payment in the app | Yes, SSU only |
| Talk to on-chain contracts | Yes |
| Let users sign in with a wallet | Yes |
| Store business data | Yes — see [App data](/build/data/) |

There is no other in-app payment channel. Do not ask the builder to add an external payment provider.
